high_level_description: stc brand style, a professional trade show booth photograph of Middle Eastern men in traditional attire gathered around a red podium in front of a large purple display.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A convention center exhibition space with visible ceiling infrastructure, other booths in the background, and even, bright indoor lighting.

elements.desc: A group of Middle Eastern men in traditional Arab attire, including thobes and ghutras, some wearing sunglasses and lanyards, gathered in a handshake around a red podium.
A large purple and white minimalist display panel behind the group.
A large number displayed prominently on the purple booth display panel.
A small sign in the top left corner of the booth directing visitors to the booth location.
